scope: Exact owner-selected dossier enrichment for the published MetOcean Telematics organization, preserving the production identity and review-first boundary.

prospects.name: MetOcean Telematics
prospects.fitSummary: MetOcean Telematics lets a reviewer assess whether its Dartmouth iSLDMB, PABLO, NiKA, STREAM and MASS portfolio warrants distinct buyer conversations; USAspending.gov and Frontiers independently separate current USCG orders and operational PABLO use from vendor-only performance claims.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed MetOcean's current Dartmouth operating footprint, product families, public contact route and owner-controlled manufacturing claims.
Resolved NiKA depth, hydrophone, endurance and surfaced Certus data-return architecture while retaining vendor-performance limits.
Confirmed legal recipient, business number and Dartmouth location through the federal contribution record; private ownership remains undisclosed.
Checked current Canadian trademark and historical patent trails; no new active-patent claim changed the dossier decision.
Resolved the USCG parent BPA and three iSLDMB calls plus the DND NiKA/PAMS award without inferring unit count, delivery or acceptance.
Confirmed Controlled Goods registration through 2031-01-28 while leaving clearance, cyber-accreditation and configuration scope unresolved.
Reviewed current Canadian contract history and retained distinct government buyer and contribution records without summing amendments as revenue.
Resolved independent PABLO deployment, Brazilian Navy iSLDMB sustainment, Canadian Coast Guard integration support and FLANQ counterparty evidence.
Checked English and French Canadian procurement surfaces; no separate canonical French company site was found.

Final certification and counterparty falsification found Bracer FIPS and STREAM1 temperature conflicts, but no current ISO certificate or durable counterparty proof for KSSL or ZeroUSV; the MASS award was confirmed while commissioning remains unknown.
